notes.title: Update 12/07/2018
notes.content:
Small update for 12/07/18

- Fixed songs not looping when they were supposed to during levels.
- Fixed updated flame sometimes being 90 degrees the wrong way.
- Hid secret mega coin
- Cleaned up poop that fell all the way down to Earth and landed in my yard.

notes.title: Update 15/01/18
notes.content:
Fixed the following simple yet annoying issues:

- Fixed bug that should now allow 32bit users to run the game as was intended originally.

- Removed "Wall of Death" 

- Modified missile flame slightly


More big updates coming soon!

(Maybe more hats?...)
